about: Build tasks for agents. One task = one branch = one PR. Fields: area (data/areas.json id), priority 1 (first) to 3, kind, photos to build from (public/photos-ref), build (what to make), avoid (what not to do), accept (checks that must pass, beyond the standard set in docs/HANDOVER.md), dependsOn (task ids), status open | in-progress | done, owner (agent or person working on it), issue (GitHub issue number in daveyboyc/villacana-venture; close it from the task's PR). scripts/build_references.py turns this into refs/QUEUE.md, per-area task lists, graph nodes and issue bodies in refs/issues/.

tasks.title: Elena north: path and garden door between the two hedged beds
tasks.build: The short paved path running east between elena-north-tree-bed-1 and tree-bed-2 to a white garden wall with a brown timber door (and a small barred window in that wall). Add the wall segment only as far as the photos show it.
tasks.avoid: Do not continue the wall past what IMG_2199/2201 show; do not close the path.
accept: check_elena_north.py extended for the new wall
layout browser test walks into the path and stops at the door

tasks.title: Elena north: private patios east of the beds
tasks.build: The walled private patios between the Elena beds and the east terrace: white patio walls with bougainvillea, a timber pergola, paving. Trace walls from the roof shots against the aerial and registry; patios are private, so walls are solid.
tasks.avoid: Roof shots: the pin is the roof, not the subject. Trace only walls visible in at least one photo.

tasks.title: Elena: gated tiled entry west of the covered walkway
tasks.build: The narrow gated entry seen looking down in IMG_2361: patterned tiles, a pair of black iron gates in a white gateway topped with bougainvillea, at the west end of the covered walkway (registry part 6265201UF1366N_part5).
tasks.avoid: Keep the walkway open underneath; do not invent further gates.
accept: walkway still walkable end to end

tasks.title: Cervantes: two steps up to a front door west of the Elena junction
tasks.build: Two red-tread steps with white sides climbing to a brown timber door on the north side of Cervantes, just west of the ramp drain, between a plumbago hedge and bougainvillea.
tasks.avoid: The door belongs to a house: steps stop at the facade; do not narrow the lane or the steps beside the ramp.
accept: layout test still climbs the ramp steps

tasks.title: Cervantes/Elena junction lawns: pollarded trees and kerbs from the new photos
tasks.build: Place the pollarded trees and check the lawn outlines and white kerbs in data/frontage_divisions.json against the roof views (IMG_2358, IMG_2367).
tasks.avoid: Change lawn rings only where a roof shot shows them clearly.
accept: frontage regions still pass their checks

tasks.title: Cervantes east of Elena: white kerb wall and plumbago hedge
tasks.build: The low white kerb wall and tall plumbago hedge on the north side of Cervantes east of the junction, as far as IMG_2356 shows.
tasks.avoid: Unphotographed eastern frontage stays unasserted (see docs/FRONTAGE_DIVISIONS.md).
accept: check_cervantes_patio_walls.py or a new check passes

tasks.title: Walled patios along Cervantes from the roof views
tasks.build: Patio walls and planting of the gardens north of Cervantes, traced from the three roof shots against the aerial and registry.
tasks.avoid: Roof shots: trace only what is clearly visible; mark extents estimated.

tasks.title: Middle pool south-west: stone steps and the gateway at their top
tasks.build: Three rough stone steps climbing the tiled path between the hedge and the raised planter to a white gateway with bougainvillea; the level change they imply (check against data/terrain.json).
tasks.avoid: Do not move the planter built in data/middle_pool.json; a level change needs check_terrain.py updated, like the Cervantes steps (docs/ELENA_NORTH.md).
accept: player climbs the steps one riser at a time (copy the Cervantes steps test)

tasks.title: Middle pool south: iron double gate under a pergola frame
tasks.build: Black iron double gate under a curved metal pergola frame, crazy paving with a drain, the raised white planter with a step and the blue tile panel beside it.
tasks.avoid: Gate stays open and walkable unless a photo shows it shut.

tasks.title: Middle pool north-west: curved planter end, white steps, brown-door wall
tasks.build: The curved north end of the raised planter, the white steps by the north-west entrance, and the white garden wall with a brown door and pergola entrance north of the west path.
tasks.avoid: IMG_2331 (±17 m) and IMG_2332 (±14 m) have poor pins: place from the pool ring, path and aerial, not the pins. Correct their pins in data/photo_positions.json first.

tasks.title: Calle Eva: walled lawn corner with espaliered bougainvillea
tasks.build: The two white walls of the lawn corner beside the middle pool east gateway, espaliered bougainvillea (a wall-texture or flat sprite, not crossed cards), green bollard lights; the lawns and lamp posts along Eva.
tasks.avoid: Do not change the east gateway built in data/middle_pool.json.

tasks.title: Paseo: sandstone retaining wall, mesh fence and level drop
tasks.build: Yellow sandstone retaining wall about 1.2 m high with a green mesh fence on top along the landward side of the paseo, and the level difference it holds.
tasks.avoid: Keep the coastal gate and every lane reaching the paseo open.

tasks.title: South pool: lawn level above the paseo and its seaward wall
tasks.build: Make the south pool lawn stand above the paseo by the height of the retaining wall (IMG_2349 shows the pool area right above it) and reconcile skeleton.seaWall with the sandstone wall.
tasks.avoid: Pools stay level (check_terrain.py).

tasks.title: Barraka Beach: boardwalk, sign planter and parasols
tasks.build: Timber boardwalk across the sand from the paseo to the restaurant, the BARRAKA BEACH painted planter, thatched parasols and loungers (Details).
tasks.avoid: Beach props are Details only and must keep the route clearance.

tasks.title: Beach: shoreline outline vs IMG_2285 (pin falls in the sea)
tasks.build: Check the sea/beach outline against the beach photos and the aerial; IMG_2285 was taken on the beach but its pin is in the map sea polygon. Correct the outline only with independent map evidence.
tasks.avoid: Do not move the outline to fit one GPS pin.

tasks.title: North pool: curved garden walls and raised patios
tasks.build: Trace the curved white garden walls (about 1 m), raised patios with tiled steps and the crazy-paving path round the lawn from the upper-floor photos (and private reference photos 03-07 if available), replacing generated wall blocks in that band.
tasks.avoid: Upper-floor shots: pins are inside buildings. Follow the AGENTS.md rule against repeated invented walls.

tasks.title: Seaward lanes: octagonal paving and covered passages
tasks.build: An octagonal terracotta paving texture for the lanes that use it, and patterned-tile floors in the covered passages.
tasks.avoid: Materials only; no geometry changes.

tasks.title: Pintor Picasso: service road, utility sheds and bins
tasks.build: The asphalt service road, low white utility sheds with brown doors, the boundary wall, the stone-plinth building with railings and ramp, recycling bins (Details).
tasks.avoid: Outside the walkable resort core: keep it simple and evidence-backed.

tasks.title: Paseo: re-trace the promenade line from the retaining wall
tasks.build: The mapped (OSM) paseo is 1-3 m off the real one: in places a sand strip shows between the paseo and the wall that the photos do not have, elsewhere the wall had to be held 1.8 m in. Re-trace the paseo centreline about 1.5 m seaward of data/paseo_wall.json, regenerate skeleton.json and remove the 1.8 m hold-in.
tasks.avoid: Keep the coastal gate connector and the Barraka boardwalk joins; regenerate skeleton.json with scripts/build_skeleton.py, never by hand.
accept: paseo still walks end to end

tasks.title: Paseo east end: wall height towards the big pool
tasks.build: The model makes the wall rise to 3 m over its last 40 m because the paseo falls to big-pool level; IMG_2227 from the beach suggests it stays about 1 m. Settle it (a new photo from the paseo near Calle Guillermo would decide) and adjust the paseo or big-pool levels in data/main_pool.json.
tasks.avoid: Do not change the big-pool level without evidence; Dave set it. Ask for a photo if the existing ones do not decide it.

tasks.title: Paseo east: registry house 6465801UF1366N_part5 blocks the walk
tasks.build: Further east than the boardwalk the mapped paseo passes 0.64 m from registry house 6465801UF1366N_part5, so the player is blocked. Find whether the paseo line or the footprint is wrong (aerial, photos) and fix the one that is.
tasks.avoid: Registry footprints stay unless a photo-backed correction is the point; prefer re-tracing the paseo.
accept: layout browser test walks the whole paseo end to end

tasks.title: Paseo: hedges behind the fence, windbreak cloth, lamp posts
tasks.build: Clipped hedges behind the mesh fence, the green windbreak cloth on parts of it, the slim white lamp posts and the service cover, all Details only.
tasks.avoid: Details must keep the paseo route clearance.
